measurement.dependencyBoundary: Entire original function result, unchanged concurrency12 and original cache/link rules. Import calls no build/browser/API/export other than the exact capture.
measurement.output: dependency-fingerprint.json is the exact returned object serialized once; capture-result.json binds complete file count, link count, tool hash/version, monotonic elapsed and fingerprint hash.
measurement.dependencyMutationLimitation: Single pass is not a filesystem snapshot. Inputs must be exclusively stable. No second tree scan or capture is performed to assert stability. Package/source pins and CI idle guards cannot prove the absence of arbitrary concurrent foreign writes.

resourceProfile.heapJustification: Capture retains path/hash records and twelve asynchronous file streams, not a Vite graph or .NET runtime. 512MiB V8 heap plus native/I/O overhead stays within the separate 2GiB Job cap, preserving the 4GiB admission reserve. Exhaustion yields an incomplete diagnostic; caps never trigger a reduced file boundary or retry.
resourceProfile.CPUConcurrency: Original metadata/read/hash concurrency12 retained; no global profile/affinity change. One controlled Node worker only.

knownLimitations: No OS disk snapshot: single-pass dependencies can change between file reads; exclusivity is an external prerequisite
Foreign short-lived CI processes between one-second Worker samples can be missed; no exclusive GitHub lease is acquired or claimed
Own short-lived descendants may be missed by sampling; kernel non-breakaway Job kill-on-close is the containment boundary, exhaustive historical process absence is not claimed
If the controller is forcibly killed, kernel close of its non-inherited Job handle terminates remaining owned members; no durable completion receipt is then guaranteed
